translations.web: “ ‘None of you shall approach any close relatives, to uncover their nakedness: I am Yahweh.
translations.bsb: None of you are to approach any close relative to have sexual relations. I am the LORD.
translations.kjv: None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him, to uncover their nakedness: I am the LORD.
translations.asv: None of you shall approach to any that are near of kin to him, to uncover their nakedness: I am Jehovah.
